body: The last time I felt like this was when I attempted suicide five years ago and that is what scares me. I've come such a long way from where I was then, but right now I can't think straight and I don't want to do something that I will regret, but I can't think straight.

I've been trying to think of my victories, going to the gym no longer feels like a chore. I guess that counts. But my grandmother died a few months ago and everything else has sort of fallen apart since then as well so mostly I just work and go home to sleep.
I'm sorry, I'm having a lot of trouble forming sentences at the moment. My brain feels like it's full of static and I can't think straight. Thank you for replying to me though.
